system_pass.name: System Pass
system_pass.description: Automatically completes a Daily Quest of your choice.
system_pass.lore: "The System grants reprieve. But the body does not forget."

xp_crystal.name: XP Crystal
xp_crystal.description: You absorb the crystal's energy. +100 XP immediately.
xp_crystal.lore: "A relic of a forgotten dungeon. It glows with latent power."

health_potion.name: Recovery Potion
health_potion.description: Restores motivation. Grants +30 XP and +10 Gold immediately.
health_potion.lore: "It tastes like determination. Drink it when your strength falters."

rest_scroll.name: Rest Scroll
rest_scroll.description: Reduces the next day's penalty by 50%.
rest_scroll.lore: "Even the greatest Hunters need strategic rest."

lagrima_purificacao.name: Tear of Purification
lagrima_purificacao.description: Immediately removes the active penalty debuff.
lagrima_purificacao.lore: "Distilled from pain and redemption. A second chance the System rarely grants."

relogio_ampulheta.name: Hourglass
relogio_ampulheta.description: The next completed Quest grants double XP.
relogio_ampulheta.lore: "Time bends for the worthy. But only once."

quebra_feiticos.name: Spell Breaker
quebra_feiticos.description: Allows you to abandon Hardcore Focus Mode without additional cost.
quebra_feiticos.lore: "Forged in the depths of the darkest dungeon. Breaks any oath... at a price already paid."

loot_box.name: Mystery Chest
loot_box.description: A chest sealed by System magic. May contain Gold, XP or Rare Keys.
loot_box.lore: "What lies within? Only the System decides."

theme_monarch.name: Theme: Shadow Sovereign
theme_monarch.description: A deep black and purple UI that reflects absolute power.
theme_monarch.lore: "Rise with the crown that rules the dead."

theme_blood.name: Theme: Blood Night
theme_blood.description: A dark scarlet UI for the relentless hunters.

evolution_shard_common.name: Evolution Shard
evolution_shard_common.description: Basic material to evolve any unit. Required in all upgrades.
evolution_shard_common.lore: "The raw material of growth. Each shard carries the echo of a battle."

void_crystal.name: Void Crystal
void_crystal.description: Rare crystal from dimensional rifts. Required to evolve Knight+ units or at level milestones (×10).
void_crystal.lore: "It exists between dimensions. The Void gazes back at you through it."

beast_core.name: Beast Core
beast_core.description: Core extracted from bestial creatures. Amplifies Beast or Insect type units.
beast_core.lore: "The raw essence of the predator. It pulses with an instinct impossible to tame."

phantom_essence.name: Phantom Essence
phantom_essence.description: Distilled from dungeon souls. Required to evolve Undead, Phantom or Demon shadows.
phantom_essence.lore: "It is not death that frightens — it is what remains after it."

shadow_essence.name: Shadow Essence
shadow_essence.description: Concentrated essence of captured shadows. Resets the day's shadow extraction limit, allowing a new extraction.
shadow_essence.lore: "Darkness has a price. And sometimes, it pays you back."

blood_fallen.name: Blood of the Fallen
blood_fallen.description: Collected from hunters who fell in battle. Activates buff: +25% Gold on all quests for 3 hours.
blood_fallen.lore: "The blood of the weak fertilizes the path of the strong."

viper_venom.name: Viper Venom
viper_venom.description: Extracted from the Venomous Serpent. Activates buff: +15% XP on all quests for 2 hours.
viper_venom.lore: "The viper's poison does not kill — it transforms."

crimson_knight_shard.name: Crimson Knight Shard
crimson_knight_shard.description: A fragment of the Crimson Knight's armor. Activates buff: +20% XP on all quests for 1 hour.
crimson_knight_shard.lore: "The Crimson Knight served in silence. His fragment still serves."

cerberus_fang.name: Cerberus Fang
cerberus_fang.description: Tooth of the abyss guardian. Activates buff: +20% Gold on all quests for 2 hours.
cerberus_fang.lore: "Three heads, one fate: to serve the Sovereign."

iron_will_crystal.name: Iron Will Crystal
iron_will_crystal.description: Crystallization of pure determination. Activates buff: +50% XP on all quests for 30 minutes.

lich_eye.name: Lich Eye
lich_eye.description: The eye that sees beyond death. Activates buff: +100% XP (double) on all quests for 1 hour.
lich_eye.lore: "He who stares death in the face grows stronger."

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.description: Natural armor of the king of monsters. Activates buff: +30% XP on all quests for 4 hours.
dragon_scale.lore: "Not even fire melts what was forged in fire."

crimson_knight_soul.name: Crimson Knight Soul
crimson_knight_soul.description: Remnant of the Crimson Knight's essence. Activates buff: +25% XP for 2 hours.
crimson_knight_soul.lore: "The Crimson Knight died on his knees. His soul serves standing."

cerberus_tooth.name: Cerberus Tooth
cerberus_tooth.description: Torn from the three-headed abyss guardian. Activates buff: +25% Gold for 2 hours.
cerberus_tooth.lore: "Three heads, one end. Its teeth guard the secret of the Abyss."

ui.ad_gold_desc: Watch a voluntary ad and receive 500 Gold.
ui.shadow_recruitment_subtitle: Unleash the power of darkness for a Gold price.
